notes: οὕτως … καί is split *so* / *also* as rule 100 requires; rule 82 governs only where no οὕτως stands, and καθάπερ keeps its bare *as*.
The elliptical final clause expresses no predicate, so the supplied copula rides with the subject under rule 56, and the article before Χριστός stands unrepresented under rule 23.
